newsitem.title: USA: N.J. hospitals say need more aid for charity care.
newsitem.headline: N.J. hospitals say need more aid for charity care.

text.p: Two dozen urban hospitals warned New Jersey they face financial ruin unless the state finds a way to repay them for charity care.
The alliance said urban hospitals bear a disproportionate share of the costs of treating the uninsured and poor.
It said the state has decreased its charity care fund to $300 million, which is only about half the amount the alliance regards as its minimum need.
At a news conference Thursday, an alliance spokesman said a survey of 1996 finances showed some hospitals would no longer be able to operate without a boost in state aid.
